description: Eight two-state voltage sources in 8HP, each with an on level, an off level and a button that switches between them

params.text: Switches all eight sections at once, toggling them unless the menu is set to force them all on or all off
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press switching and the next switching back, in place of a state that lasts while the button is held
Scales every output between -1x and +1x, and comes up at +1x so the knobs pass through until you turn it
Switches that section between its on level and its off level, while it is held or until the next press when its latch button is on
Sets the voltage that section carries while it is off, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise
Sets the voltage that section carries while it is on, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise

inputs.text: Switches all eight sections from outside, read as a trigger while the All latch button is on and as a gate otherwise

outputs.text: Carries one channel per section, each at that section's current level
Carries the on or the off voltage of the section beside it, scaled by the attenuvert knob

notes: both level knobs come up at 0V, so a new module puts out nothing until you dial in an on level
this module has no inputs for the levels themselves; CV-Toggle 8 is the version where they come from jacks
menu: Set ON-knobs 1-8 — sets all eight on knobs at once to a named set, among them a run of semitone intervals and a spread of negative and positive volts
Set OFF-knobs 1-8 — sets all eight off knobs at once to a named set
Set ON/OFF buttons 1-8: Latched, Unlatched — sets all eight latch buttons at once
All-button mode: All OFF, All ON, Toggle ALL — chooses what the ALL button and the ALL input do to the eight sections
Attenuate mode: Both, Only ON-levels, Only OFF-levels — chooses which of the two level sets the attenuvert knob scales
Poly output channels: 1 (monophonic) up to 8 channels — sets how many of the eight sections the polyphonic jack carries; a red light beside that jack shows when it is not 8
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
